message: No detected input validation: No schema, dtype, or value-range validation is performed on the incoming data; the only assertion present is a shape check inside metric functions, not on raw input data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data and pretrained models are loaded without any checksum verification, pinned revisions, or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained weights are loaded via torchvision's models (e.g., models.resnet18, models.alexnet, models.vgg11_bn) with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before use.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Validation data is split from the same train_loader with no isolation guarantees, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and only a single set of metrics is computed without independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads data via a DataLoader with no visible shape, range, or schema validation before passing inputs to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The metric functions compute accuracy from raw outputs without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation on model predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision/classification pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
